pages.text: Varanosuchus was a pseudosuchian from Sao Khua Formation of Thailand, dating back to the Early Cretaceous. Its name consists of 'Varano' a reference to the genus monitor lizards reside in due to its resemblance to them, and 'suchus' meaning crocodile. It was a medium sized animal about 115 centimeters long. Unlike modern species, its jaws weren't flattened and rather deep which also helps it be distinguished from other pseudosuchians of its locality.
While not much is known about the family it resides in, from its skeleton it can be guessed that it lived a terrestrial life with some adaptations for water.
